summary: Tested public Expo login at 390x844 and backend health/auth protection. Login rendered without overflow or visible errors; one unauthenticated liveness contract check failed.

minor.issue: A request without Bearer auth and without multipart fields returns 422 validation error instead of required 401 authentication response.

action_items: Ensure authentication is evaluated before multipart/body validation for POST /api/liveness/verify, or add a dependency that guarantees unauthenticated requests return 401.
Provide a real approved Google identity/session token to verify authenticated camera, location, attendance, admin, profile, and navigation flows.
Run adversarial real-device testing for the free DIY liveness verifier before production claims.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; the stated contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL. The deployed env contains EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so preview works, but this naming mismatch can break environments that only provide the required key.
Authenticated and native flows were not executed because no Google credentials/session token are available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://face-check-attend-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Public login passed at 390x844 with no horizontal overflow and no visible errors. GET /api/ returned 200; auth/me, liveness/session, and attendance invalid-token checks returned 401. Bodyless POST /api/liveness/verify returned 422 due to FastAPI multipart validation before auth. No Google test identity/session token is available.
rca_of_issue: FastAPI validates required Form/File parameters before entering verify_liveness and before get_current_user executes, so a bodyless unauthenticated request fails schema validation with 422. A multipart-shaped request would be needed to isolate auth, but the requested no-auth contract expects 401 regardless of body.
